## Funding & How to cite

OPOSSUM is open-source research software financed through externally funded projects:

- **THRILL** — funded by the European Union under grant agreement No 101095207.
- **LASE-FUSE** — funded by the German Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space (BMFTR), funding reference 13F1041.

Per-project attribution: see the [Funding & Acknowledgments](https://github.com/opossum-labs/opossum/blob/main/doc/book/src/concepts/background/funding.md) page.

**To cite OPOSSUM**, use the [`CITATION.cff`](https://github.com/opossum-labs/opossum/blob/main/CITATION.cff) file — GitHub's *"Cite this repository"* button exports BibTeX/APA automatically.
